t: What Corrosion Mechanism Database Is All About
title: What Corrosion Mechanism Database Is All About
description: Corrosion is electrochemistry: metal oxidizes at an anode, something reduces at a cathode, and ions travel through an electrolyte. Rust needs iron, oxygen, AND water — remove any one and it stops. Stainless steel resists via a chromium oxide passive layer, but chloride punches through it (pitting). The global cost runs ~3-4% of GDP; understanding mechanisms is the cheapest prevention. This database is the complete corrosion mechanism: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Corrosion Mechanism Database: a complete reference database of full corrosion mechanism records.
key_points: What this database holds: full corrosion mechanism records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.
